heading: Chap. ii.—Maintain union with the bishop.
paragraphs:
Wherefore, as children
of light and truth,
flee from division and
wicked doctrines; but
where the shepherd is,
there do ye as sheep
follow. For there are
many wolves that appear
worthy of credit,
who, by means of a pernicious
pleasure, carry
captive[1147] those that are
running towards God;
but in your unity they
shall have no place.

Wherefore, as children of light
and truth, avoid the dividing of
your unity, and the wicked doctrine
of the heretics, from whom “a defiling
influence has gone forth into
all the earth.”[1148] But where the
shepherd is, there do ye as sheep
follow. For there are many wolves
in sheep’s clothing,[1149] who, by means
of a pernicious pleasure, carry captive[1150]
those that are running towards
God; but in your unity they shall
have no place.
